task: Implement the /login page for SAA 2025 from the MoMorph design (screen GzbNeVGJHz) with Supabase local Google OAuth, VN/EN i18n, route guarding, and a protected /todo placeholder (feature F001).
acceptanceCriteria: /login renders the SAA 2025 design with VN default locale
Google OAuth starts same-tab via Supabase signInWithOAuth and /auth/callback exchanges the code
Unauthenticated /todo redirects to /login and authenticated /login redirects to /todo
OAuth failure shows the localized error directly under the login button via error=oauth param
Language selector switches vi/en instantly and persists the NEXT_LOCALE cookie
/todo shows name email avatar and logout returns to /login
npm test tsc eslint and build all exit 0
blastRadius: src/proxy.ts matcher affects every route except static assets and /auth/callback
eslint.config.mjs globalIgnores now excludes .claude/** from npm run lint
next.config.ts images.remotePatterns allows googleusercontent.com avatar hosts
root scaffold home page / is untouched and prerendered static
contracts: LOGIN_ERROR_PARAM=error LOGIN_ERROR_VALUE=oauth shared between callback and login page
NEXT_LOCALE cookie contract between set-locale-action and get-request-locale (vi|en, fallback vi)
env contract: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
